title: Doing-act
description: JSON Schema for a doing-act — one settling-step v_τ → v_{τ+1} of a predication-settling, realized as a single nucleus application (σ-firing or Δ-stabilization) at one affected cell. Carries the cell coordinate, the before- and after- bilattice-values witnessing settling monotonicity (value-before ≤_k value-after), the kind discriminator pinning stratum, the non-empty deps-chain of premise cell-ids, the derived-via gerund slug naming the closure-rule or stabilization operator, the Belnap classification of the produced value, the ISO-8601 transaction-id, and the optional post-act closure-status label.

value-before.description: v_τ at the affected cell — the predication-valuation's value at this cell before the step. Witnesses the source of the morphism.

value-after.description: v_{τ+1} at the affected cell — the predication-valuation's value at this cell after the step. Must be ≥_k value-before per settling monotonicity; the script enforces this constraint, which JSON Schema cannot express directly.

kind.description: Which nucleus realized the step. 'sigma' is the closure-operator (σ-nucleus) — emits a stratum-1 saturated atom from a closure-rule firing. 'delta' is the bilattice-stabilization-nucleus (Δ-nucleus) — emits a stratum-2 settled atom from a T_a^* fixed-point.

stratum.description: The output stratum, pinned from kind. 'saturated' (stratum-1) for σ-acts; 'settled' (stratum-2) for Δ-acts. Stratum 'asserted' is the positing-face (predicating) and is not a doing-act.

derived-from.description: Non-empty list of premise cell-ids — atoms at strata ≤ 1 (for σ) or ≤ 2 (for Δ) consumed by the firing. Records the deps-chain in the stratified-predication-fiber's witness graph; acyclicity along the trajectory is the fiber's structural property.

derived-via.description: Gerund-slug naming the closure-rule (for σ-acts) or stabilization operator (for Δ-acts; conventionally 'bilattice-stabilization').

belnap-class.description: By-produced-value Belnap classification of value-after's symbol: 'inferring' (t), 'refuting' (f), 'idling' (bot), 'conflicting' (top).

closure-status.description: Optional post-act closure-status of the affected cell, from the orthogonal taxonomy: 'fully-settled' (σ-fixed ∧ Δ-fixed), 'saturation-pending' (¬σ-fixed ∧ Δ-fixed), 'stabilization-pending' (σ-fixed ∧ ¬Δ-fixed), 'fully-open' (neither fixed).
